conditions.doc: `weapon:<id>`: the weapon in Rivet's hands (none = unarmed).
`heat:<op><N>`: the wanted level against N (op one of >= <= > < == =, default ==).

doc: The quest runtime vocabulary (features/quest): every objective verb it plays and how, the fail-state keyword rules it can detect (the first rule whose every keyword group matches as whole words wins), the bark condition kinds (state conditions `kind:value`) and event tags (a bare tag that holds for event_window_s after a typed Events signal). PoF reads this table to guard what the quest council may emit (docs/data-contracts.md). Souls, madness bands and weapons follow pitch.md (provisional until canon lands in this repo).

event_tags.doc: Events.wave_started: a combat encounter wave began.
Events.whispers_spiked: the voices in Rivet's head spiked.
The contract's own sabotage objective completed.

fail_rules.doc: Rivet died: the contract fails (respawn and checkpoints belong to the save layer).
The kill target got further than escape_m from Rivet.
A gate, not a failure: answer, meet and a payphone evade complete only at wanted 0 (Patch drops a hot caller), and the contract goes on.

verbs.doc: Reach the location marker (on foot or driving). objective.location names a place marker.
Bring Rivet (or the vehicle he drives) to the location marker. objective.location names a place marker.
Get into the target vehicle. objective.target names a tag the world resolves (places.vehicles / places.actors).
Get into the target vehicle. objective.target names a tag the world resolves (places.vehicles / places.actors).
Kill the target actor; it escapes past escape_m when target_escapes is a fail state. objective.target names a tag the world resolves (places.vehicles / places.actors).
Kill the target actor. objective.target names a tag the world resolves (places.vehicles / places.actors).
Last objective.durationS seconds (legacy: a "<N>s" target, else survive_default_s).
The target ally follows Rivet to the location marker; escort_dies fails it. objective.target names a tag the world resolves (places.vehicles / places.actors). objective.location names a place marker.

Lose the heat: done at wanted 0. When the location's marker has a payphone, it then rings and Rivet must answer it on foot. objective.target is prose for the player and the art pass; the handler does not read it. objective.location names a place marker.

Answer the payphone at the location's marker on foot (it rings only at wanted 0 when arrived_hot is a fail state). objective.target is prose for the player and the art pass; the handler does not read it. objective.location names a place marker.

Reach the location (at wanted 0 when arrived_hot is a fail state); done once the beat's lines have played. objective.target is prose for the player and the art pass; the handler does not read it. objective.location names a place marker.

Clear the combat encounter the world holds at the location (places.encounters). objective.target is prose for the player and the art pass; the handler does not read it. objective.location names a place marker.

Clear the location's encounter, then interact at its marker on foot (torch, plant, smash). objective.target is prose for the player and the art pass; the handler does not read it. objective.location names a place marker.
